payload.summary: codex review round 1 (run 83py8v8v): REQUEST CHANGES, one finding, and it is a real regression the desktop verification could not see. Below 859px #row-hands collapses to grid-template-columns: 1fr and .hand-divider is display: none — so the per-seat seating rules were seating both halves against a centre line that no longer exists, throwing the player's group and total to the stacked row's RIGHT rim and the banker's to its LEFT. Fixed by giving the 859px block an explicit fallback: both seats return to the shared flush-left shape (label total pad, forward card order), and the player's third card takes the banker's rotation and displacement because dealing forward makes it the rightmost item again. Guarded by a new test that walks the @media block with balanced braces, plus three mutations — fallback deleted, player row left reversed, player rotation left mirrored — all three fail the suite. Verified live at 820px: both seats flush at offset 0, identical rotation matrix, no lane overflow. Codex also raised a non-blocking note that HAND_ROW_TRACKS duplicates two token values; that duplication is deliberate and the test asserts the two agree, so it cannot drift silently.
